30. BOOK BINDER TRAINING 
 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
The Visually Impaired candidates are imparted Book 
Binder training at the Government higher secondary school 
for Visually Impaired, Poonamallee every year. 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria 
The Visually impaired persons who have passed 8th
standard and Age limit 18 to 40..
